provider: PulsedMedia Storage Boxes — 4 TB at €8.99/mo + a genuinely free 50 GiB/30-day box

free_tier.stated: Storage Boxes from 4 TB (€8.99/mo, RAID5) to 32 TB. Separately, a FREE 30-day seedbox: 50 GiB storage, 250 MB RAM, 200 GiB torrent traffic, SSH + SFTP + Docker rootless.

egress.terms: Unlimited bandwidth at 100 Mbps plus 10 Gbps burst on the paid boxes. The free box gets 200 GiB of traffic only.

tooling: SSH, SCP, SFTP, FTP(S), HTTPS. Docker rootless means you can run rclone or a WebDAV server inside it.
chaining: The free box is explicitly one-per-customer with a newsletter signup as the price ('Signing up for FREE Seedbox you enroll to marketing newsletter maximum twice per month'; 'Only 1 Seedbox per user!'). Not stackable — the provider says outright that the guardrails exist because 'a free seedbox is catnip for spammers and ratio-cheaters', which in plain terms means the free box attracts users who take more than it is meant for.
limits_note: Free tier: 50 GiB, terminates after 30 days, 200 GiB traffic, zero slots available at read time ('Available: 0'). Paid: 100 Mbps sustained is the egress ceiling.
reliability_note: 12+ year veteran seedbox host, own hardware in Helsinki. Unusually honest about the free tier's economics, which is the useful data point.

evidence.proved: 'Free Seedbox Trial 30 Days … 50 GiB Storage … 200 GiB Torrent traffic … Terminates after 30 Days … Available: 0'; 'one per customer, limited slots, and you're signed up to our newsletter'
